summary: Saddle Mountain, Ravalli County, Montana: camp in 1939, pole L-4 tower built 1941 near Lost Trail Pass, torn down 1972; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Torn down in 1972 per firelookout.com; firelookout.org lists the tower as gone and the Forest Lookouts entry page marks it Removed.

evidence.supports: location 2 miles northwest of Lost Trail Pass
evidence.quote: 2 miles northwest of Lost Trail Pass

evidence.supports: site established as a camp in 1939
pole L-4 tower built 1941, described as 10' pole

evidence.supports: known lookout personnel listed for 1945, 1958 and 1961
evidence.quote: Known lookout personnel: 1945: Sally Voulkas; 1958: Luther Britton; 1961: Robert Williams.

firelookout.org list shows the tower gone

notes_for_editor: Brief coordinates and county match the firelookout.org list. Access is left unset because no source covers it. Staffing names are in the evidence quotes only; the story gives years, not names. A search result described a 1939 camp, 1941 tower and 1972 removal for a Saddle Mountain near the Lost Trail ski area on the Idaho side; that page was not read and is not cited. The weebly page links its entry to 'Rex's fire lookout page', which we did not locate for the Montana site (a search surfaced an Idaho Saddle Mountain page under that name); check the link target before relying on it. No photos or current-site description found.
